name: BetterRecs
description: Better recommendations for Jellyfin. Replaces the built-in Similar Items with a multi-dimensional weighted scoring engine, and adds personalised 'Because you watched ...' rows for the home screen. Matches on genres, tags, community rating, parental rating, release year, and cast/crew. Fully configurable through the dashboard.
overview: Smarter 'Similar Items' plus 'Because you watched ...' home-screen recommendation rows.
changelog: Renamed to BetterRecs. Added 'Because you watched ...' personalised recommendation sections, exposed via the /BetterRecs/Recommendations API, with full configuration (section count, items per section, recommend-watched, cross-type movie/series recommendations).
